o.text:
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *til (“tongue; language”). Cognate with Turkish dil.
Further cognates
Cognate with Old Uyghur [script needed] (dïl), Karakhanid [script needed] (dïl), Turkmen dil (“to rise”), Crimean Tatar til, Uzbek til, Uyghur تىل (til) Kazakh тіл (til), Kyrgyz тил (til), Southern Altai тил (til), Tatar тел (tel), Bashkir тел (til), Tuvan дыл (dıl),Yakut тыл (tïl), Chuvash чӗлхе (čĕlh̬e).
From tapşır- + -ıq. Cognate with Uyghur تاپشۇرۇق (tapshuruq).
From Arabic مَذْهَب (maḏhab). Cognate with Turkish mezhep.
